facts.en: Completed a certificate in Administrative Systems at Fictional Institute D070 in 2023.
facts.zh: 2023 年在虚构院校 D070 完成行政系统结业证书。

facts.en: Worked as a learning records assistant at Fictional Training Office D070 from 2024-01 to 2026-08.
facts.zh: 2024-01 至 2026-08 在虚构培训办公室 D070 担任学习记录助理。

facts.en: Entered attendance from signed session sheets and linked each record to an approved course identifier.
facts.zh: 根据签字课程表录入出勤，并将每条记录关联至获批课程标识。

facts.en: Checked participant identifiers against an authorized roster and escalated mismatches to the coordinator.
facts.zh: 将参与者标识与授权名册核对，并将不匹配情况上报协调员。

facts.en: Updated completion status only after receiving trainer-approved evidence; did not infer completion from registration.
facts.zh: 仅在收到培训师批准的证据后更新完成状态；不根据报名推断完成。

facts.en: With the records coordinator, checked 150 training records during 2025-07.
facts.zh: 在 2025-07 与记录协调员合作检查 150 条培训记录。

facts.en: The team found 12 missing attendance attachments among those 150 records, retrieved 10 from trainers and kept 2 flagged pending.
facts.zh: 团队在该批 150 条记录中发现 12 份缺失出勤附件，向培训师取得 10 份，并保留 2 份待定标记。

facts.en: Used spreadsheet validation and a learning-records system to maintain course dates, status and evidence references.
facts.zh: 使用电子表格验证及学习记录系统维护课程日期、状态及证据引用。

facts.en: Produced monthly status extracts for authorized managers and removed unnecessary personal fields before sharing.
facts.zh: 为获授权经理制作每月状态导出，并在共享前删除不必要的个人字段。

facts.en: Created a 2026-02 filing guide approved and used by the training office.
facts.zh: 在 2026-02 编制归档指南，由培训办公室批准并使用。

facts.en: Drafted an optional visual calendar in 2026-05; it remained a draft and was not adopted.
facts.zh: 2026-05 起草可选可视化日历；仍为草稿，未被采纳。

facts.en: At the 2025-09 induction peak, processed records for 11 sessions in one week; the typical 2026-08 weekly workload was 5 sessions.
facts.zh: 在 2025-09 入职培训高峰期，一周处理 11 场课程记录；2026-08 典型每周工作量为 5 场。

facts.en: Volunteered at Fictional Craft Circle V070 on Saturdays from 2024-04 to 2024-10 while employed, organizing supply labels.
facts.zh: 2024-04 至 2024-10 任职期间，星期六在虚构手工社团 V070 志愿整理用品标签。

facts.en: Built a personal index of crochet patterns; it was not a training curriculum.
facts.zh: 建立个人钩针图样索引；并非培训课程体系。

facts.en: Enjoys sketching imaginary gardens and keeps the sketches in a personal notebook.
facts.zh: 喜爱描绘想象中的花园，并将素描保留在个人笔记本中。

facts.en: Maintained a correction log linking original and amended values with the coordinator’s approval reference.
facts.zh: 维护更正记录，将原值与修改值关联，并附协调员审批引用。

facts.en: Responded to internal record queries by locating approved evidence rather than issuing new qualifications.
facts.zh: 通过查找获批证据回答内部记录查询，而非授予新资格。

facts.en: The role did not include designing curricula, certifying competence or administering payroll; the vacancy does not require these duties.
facts.zh: 该岗位不包含设计课程、认证能力或管理薪资；本空缺不要求这些职责。
